confidence_notes: Restaurant anchors are rough bounds from crowdsourced Numbeo-style averages (Fez/Morocco), with the inexpensive and mid-range meals, and the cappuccino, the least uncertain. Beer and cocktail anchors rest on hotel menus, which run high, and on a 2021 Expatistan listing, so they are wide. wine_glass is inferred from the beer anchor (about 1.5x), with no Fez wine-by-the-glass price found. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and city context. I did not inspect live booking pages or current listings. The FX observation is the most recent RBA figure I could verify (20 March 2026), not an October 2026 rate; I could not confirm a later RBA observation. MAD-to-USD conversions assume roughly 9.2 MAD per USD.
comparable_city_reasoning: Moroccan basis. Restaurant and coffee anchors use Fez-specific or Morocco-wide aggregated price data where available. Drink anchors use hotel and tourist-venue menus from Morocco, adjusted down toward local restaurant levels. Accommodation is set against Fez's medina riad and guesthouse market by general knowledge.
